title: Add bounded runtime repair executor
prompt: Add the Phase 5 bounded runtime repair executor for ADE. Create src/ade/repair_runtime.py with an immutable RepairExecution result that can represent either a successful CycleResult or a final RepairPlan plus the ordered repair history. Add run_cycle_with_repair(provider, *, task, source_name, policy=None, run_cycle_fn=run_cycle) that calls run_cycle, classifies failures through plan_repair, automatically retries only when the disposition is RETRY, and stops deterministically on REPLAN, PAUSE_QUOTA, HUMAN_WAIT, or FAIL. The retry loop must use the next_attempt and next_replan_count values from RepairPlan, must never exceed RepairPolicy bounds, and must not swallow unexpected exceptions as success. Validate inputs and keep the implementation provider-agnostic. Export the new public API from ade.__init__. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage proving: immediate success; timeout then success after one retry; repeated timeout reaches REPLAN after bounded retries; quota returns PAUSE_QUOTA without retry; human input returns HUMAN_WAIT without retry; terminal unknown error returns FAIL; and invalid arguments are rejected. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, scripts, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
